title: Servex has landed - it starts your dev servers now, so no Claude session has to

text: One command, node Servex/index.js, and visiting monorepo.localhost:8080 boots the site by itself. Read Servex/readme.md - it is one screen. One thing to know: the repo root node_modules was empty when I started, so your port-80 server would not have survived a restart; I put it back with npm ci and it is fine. Nothing for you to do except paste one line into CLAUDE.md when you want to.
